description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named PropertyAnimations, which demonstrates the use of property animations such as ObjectAnimator to animate UI elements like buttons with effects like fade, move, spin, and scale. It sets up various animations, combines them into sequences, and loads additional animations from resource files when buttons are clicked.

classes.name: PropertyAnimations
classes.description: An Android Activity class that demonstrates view property animations using ObjectAnimator and AnimatorSet, with controls to load predefined animations from resources or run custom animations on button clicks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI references, creates individual animations, sequences, and associates them with buttons for interaction.

methods.name: setupAnimation
methods.description: Helper method that assigns click behavior to a view, either loading an animator from resources or using a provided Animator object to animate the view.
